package.author: XiaoYouChR

en-US.author: XiaoYouChR
en-US.longDescription: A cross-platform fluent-design AI-boost multi-threaded downloader built with Python.
en-US.name: Ghost Downloader
en-US.releaseNotes:
Note
Following this release, updates will be less frequent due to my studies. Thank you for your understanding. Feedback is always welcome.
Buy me a coffee: Donate
New Features 🎉
- Download arXiv papers, optionally with TeX source and BibTeX (#1020) By @XiaoYouChR
- ZIP preview: browse the files in a ZIP link and download only the ones you select (#1015) By @XiaoYouChR
- Support Thunder, FlashGet and QQ Xuanfeng links By @XiaoYouChR
- Paste an Info Hash directly to add a magnet task (#1024) By @XiaoYouChR
- Online .torrent links are downloaded as BT tasks By @XiaoYouChR
- The file selection dialog supports search By @XiaoYouChR
Improvements 🔧
- The file selection dialog opens faster for tasks with tens of thousands of files By @XiaoYouChR
- HuggingFace tasks fetch a fresh download link when retried, so an expired link no longer means starting over (#985) By @XiaoYouChR
- Improved the English translation (#986) By @i0ntempest
Bug Fixes 🐛
- Fixed in-app updates failing when Ghost Downloader is installed on another drive or in a protected folder (#961, #989) By @XiaoYouChR
- Fixed the portable edition asking to reinstall runtimes after the drive letter changes or the folder is moved (#1016) By @XiaoYouChR
- Fixed some links timing out when adding many links at once. Failed links can be retried (#1014) By @XiaoYouChR
- Fixed HuggingFace gated repos failing to download after entering an Access Token, and custom mirror sites not taking effect (#1019) By @XiaoYouChR
- Fixed a crash when creating task cards on some Linux systems (#992) By @XiaoYouChR
- Fixed the whole desktop freezing when launching on KDE Wayland (#1017) By @XiaoYouChR
- Fixed clicking any notification on KDE bringing up the main window (#1001) By @XiaoYouChR
- Fixed system notifications not working on Windows (#999) By @XiaoYouChR
Feature Pack Updates 📦
- New: arxiv_pack 1.0.2, wrapped_link_pack 1.0.0, zip_pack 1.0.0. Requires v4.4.7 By @XiaoYouChR
- bittorrent_pack 1.1.3, ed2k_pack 2.0.3, ffmpeg_pack 1.1.3, github_pack 1.1.2, http_pack 1.1.7, huggingface_pack 1.1.3, m3u8_pack 1.1.4, yt_dlp_pack 1.3.6: Updated with the changes above. Requires v4.4.7 By @XiaoYouChR
Note
此次更新后, 由于本人学业原因, 将放缓更新节奏, 敬请谅解. 欢迎继续提供反馈.
请我喝杯咖啡: 捐赠项目
新功能 🎉
- 支持下载 arXiv 论文, 可选附带 TeX 源码和 BibTeX (#1020) By @XiaoYouChR
- 压缩包预览: 可浏览 ZIP 链接中的文件, 只下载勾选的文件 (#1015) By @XiaoYouChR
- 支持迅雷, 快车, QQ 旋风链接 By @XiaoYouChR
- 直接粘贴 Info Hash 即可添加磁力任务 (#1024) By @XiaoYouChR
- 在线 .torrent 链接直接作为 BT 任务下载 By @XiaoYouChR
- 选择文件对话框支持搜索 By @XiaoYouChR
功能优化 🔧
- 文件数量上万的任务打开选择文件对话框更快 By @XiaoYouChR
- HuggingFace 任务重试时会重新获取下载链接, 链接过期后不必从头下载 (#985) By @XiaoYouChR
- 改进英文翻译 (#986) By @i0ntempest
问题修复 🐛
- 修复程序装在其他磁盘或受保护目录时应用内更新失败的问题 (#961, #989) By @XiaoYouChR
- 修复便携版更换盘符或移动目录后需要重装运行环境的问题 (#1016) By @XiaoYouChR
- 修复一次添加大量链接时部分链接解析超时的问题, 解析失败的链接可重试 (#1014) By @XiaoYouChR
- 修复填写 Access Token 后仍无法下载 HuggingFace Gated Repo, 以及自定义镜像站不生效的问题 (#1019) By @XiaoYouChR
- 修复部分 Linux 环境下创建任务卡片时闪退的问题 (#992) By @XiaoYouChR
- 修复 KDE Wayland 上启动时整个桌面卡住的问题 (#1017) By @XiaoYouChR
- 修复 KDE 上点击任何通知都会弹出主窗口的问题 (#1001) By @XiaoYouChR
- 修复 Windows 上系统通知失效的问题 (#999) By @XiaoYouChR
功能包更新 📦
- 新增: arxiv_pack 1.0.2, wrapped_link_pack 1.0.0, zip_pack 1.0.0. 需要 v4.4.7 By @XiaoYouChR
- bittorrent_pack 1.1.3, ed2k_pack 2.0.3, ffmpeg_pack 1.1.3, github_pack 1.1.2, http_pack 1.1.7, huggingface_pack 1.1.3, m3u8_pack 1.1.4, yt_dlp_pack 1.3.6: 随上述改动更新. 需要 v4.4.7 By @XiaoYouChR

────────────────────────┼───────────────┼─────────────
🪟 Windows              │Setup.exe      │Download
────────────────────────┼───────────────┼─────────────
🪟 Windows              │Portable (.zip)│Download
────────────────────────┼───────────────┼─────────────
